faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.description: The things teams ask before they sign up.

items.q: Is there a free plan, and what does it include?
items.a: Yes. Free covers one workspace with up to 5 members, 2 API keys, 500 MB of storage and the AI assistant. No credit card needed, and it does not expire.

items.q: How do members and billing work?
items.a: You are billed per workspace, monthly or yearly. Invite teammates as owner, admin or member, and each role only sees what it needs. Upgrade, downgrade or switch between monthly and yearly in billing at any time.

Sign in with email, a social account or a passkey, and add two-factor authentication with an authenticator app. Sessions are revocable, every important action lands in the audit log, and roles keep access to the minimum.

items.q: What are AI credits, and what happens when they run out?
items.a: Every plan includes a monthly AI credit allowance that resets each month. If you use it up, the assistant pauses and the rest of the app keeps working. Top up credits or move to a bigger plan to carry on right away.
The whole app, your emails and this site are available in English and German. Everyone on your team picks their own language in settings.

items.q: Can I cancel, and what happens to my data?
items.a: Cancel any time from billing. Your workspace moves to the Free plan at the end of the period and your data stays. You can delete your account in settings whenever you like, which permanently removes your data.
